text: {"462":{"about":["rustc_span"],"refers":[],"why":"Macro hygiene is implemented by the hygiene machinery and syntax-context metadata in rustc_span."},"463":{"about":["rustc_span","rustc_resolve"],"refers":[],"why":"Hygienic contexts are recorded by rustc_span and used by name resolution to prevent introduced-name conflicts."},"464":{"about":["rustc_span","rustc_expand","rustc_resolve"],"refers":[],"why":"Macro expansion applies hygiene contexts, which rustc_span represents and rustc_resolve uses when resolving names."},"465":{"about":["rustc_span"],"refers":[],"why":"rustc_span stores macro-hygiene context metadata in SyntaxContext and related expansion data."},"466":{"about":["rustc_resolve"],"refers":["rustc_span"],"why":"rustc_resolve disambiguates identifiers using their hygiene context, which is represented by rustc_span."}}
